discoveredProductNotes.label: CLASS A — PRE-EXISTING AT c2ba63e
discoveredProductNotes.title: Edit-drawer start-time save can fail with INVALID_LINE
discoveredProductNotes.evidence: Time-only and time+service edits can fail with Please complete every service / INVALID_LINE even though the visible service line looks complete (service, provider, 11:00–11:30, 30 min). Service-only edit on the same drawer succeeds. Reproduced 2026-09-14 against c2ba63e. The lifecycle suite edits service, not start time, so this remains a documented product defect rather than a green-suite proof that time edit works.

discoveredProductNotes.label: CLASS A — PRE-EXISTING AT c2ba63e
discoveredProductNotes.title: Create drawer throws NotFoundError while service search repaints innerHTML
discoveredProductNotes.evidence: Uncaught NotFoundError in booking/appointments/drawer.js during every lifecycle create: Failed to set the innerHTML property on Element; the node was moved in a blur handler. Appointment still persists. Reproduced consistently against c2ba63e.

qaObservedUiRisks.title: Provider chip center can overlap an invisible start-time select hit area
qaObservedUiRisks.evidence: Playwright hit-testing on the provider chip center is intercepted by the opacity-0 start-time <select> in .ff-appt-strip-start. QA clicks the lower edge of the chip because that interaction is stable. This workaround is not proof that the product hit target is correct for a human center-click.
